title: Payload-level drug interaction labeling of antibody-drug conjugates: data and code
description:
Data and code for a cross-sectional analysis of drug interaction guidance in the US prescribing information of the 15 FDA-approved antibody-drug conjugates with current labeling. For each label, the study coded where payload interaction liabilities appear (Section 12.3 versus Section 7), the evidence behind Section 7 guidance, and consistency among products that share a payload, and examined FDA approval letters and reviews for the regulatory basis of selected recommendations. Labels were retrieved from DailyMed on November 12, 2026.

Contents: retrieval, extraction, figure, regulatory-record, and agreement scripts (Python); the coding sheet and codebook; extracted and full label text; FDA letter scan and cited review pages; figures.
